population.what: the stored 2xx item pages of the CPD-0039/0040/0041 study, extracted
population.excluded: the 109 pages of the 2026-11-15 review, the pages of the phase-3 blind control (now development material), and every page this run opened one by one (DEVELOPMENT_PREFIXES of the script)

limits: a holdout within the known population, not fresh data: the rules were developed on aggregate measurements and on listings of removed blocks across all pages
the random component (n=16) supports coarse statements only; the targeted strata find errors and do not estimate population precision

the sheet shows the blocks either version has in its BODY, without saying which version keeps which: the FOREIGN answer measures the selection's false deletions (a kept-out block that is article text) and residual contamination (a kept block that is not) of both versions; text neither version has can only be reported through MISSING

strata.method: systematic sample with a random start over the eligible pages ordered by country, outlet and sha256(seed + fetch id); inclusion probability n / N for every page

strata.what: 0.4.0 removed at least 30 % of 0.3.0's BODY words
strata.method: the first k by sha256(seed/stratum + fetch id), at most one page per outlet
strata.inclusion_probability: not equal within the stratum; not for population estimates

questions.FOREIGN: the number(s) of the blocks that are NOT text of this article (navigation, teasers, promotion, credits, embeds, repeated copies ...), comma-separated; 0 if every block is article text
questions.MISSING: complete | beginning_missing | end_missing | middle_missing | not_an_article  (is article text missing from the blocks shown, compared with the page?)
questions.CORE: yes | no | unsure  (a complete Spanish press text of running prose, at least 150 words; not a live ticker, list, page frame, paywall stub, page about the publication or paid content -- provenance does not matter)
